name: Claude Pocket Checker
summary: A separate macOS panel for regular Claude Desktop Chat: local usage estimates, isolated account totals and before-send model advice.
problem: A browser-only meter did not cover my Mac workflow, and choosing the heaviest model for every routine task made it harder to use a limited plan deliberately.
approach: I used read-only macOS Accessibility to observe the official Claude app, a volatile reply tracker and a scope-checked numeric ledger. A local draft classifier suggests a model and effort without making another AI call.
lesson: An observer needs clear ownership and honest limits. Local advice can guide a choice, but it cannot guarantee equal answers or turn API-price ratios into plan usage.
scope: Native floating panel, Accessibility parsing, state recovery, account matching, local persistence, model/effort rules and cost-scenario presentation.
